title: WP-UAT-B: type the uat evidence binding and validate it in the canonical gate (badf-uat DESIGNED → IMPLEMENTED)
objective: Carry badf-uat from DESIGNED to IMPLEMENTED, implementing exactly what rung A committed B to and nothing beyond it: a typed uat evidence schema specializing evidence.schema.json (the UAT Scenario object, the execution-observation record and the two-layer disposition record as typed artifacts), plus a badf_gate.py path validating a G10 uat dossier's typed objects -- mirroring verify for G08 and the four typed types for G09. Strictly additive: an untyped uat binding stays admissible, so nothing already landed breaks. Rung A froze the contract and shipped NO runtime, which left uat as a required G10 evidence type that no gate path could mechanically check; this rung closes that and only that.
business_value: Until this lands, a G10 dossier's uat evidence can be authored against a contract but never checked against it -- the invariants exist as prose in fourteen references and as a contract test over those references, with nothing standing between a malformed uat object and the gate. The single most valuable thing the typed form buys is that UAT-I14 stops being an argument: the recommendation enum is closed and contains no acceptance verdict, so the capability that produced the evidence cannot issue the decision by any encoding the schema admits, whether or not a producer reads the doctrine.
in_scope: schemas/uat.schema.json: typed binding -- candidate (UAT-I04), acceptance_basis (UAT-I05), scenarios (UAT-I01/I02/I06/I07), observations (UAT-I09), defects with the frozen ten-class enum (UAT-I11), coverage with REQUIRED non_coverage (UAT-I12/I13), closed recommendation enum (UAT-I14), optional Layer 2 acceptance pinning principal_type to const human (UAT-I15/I16)
scripts/badf_gate.py: check_g10_uat_binding registered EVIDENCE_RULES['uat'] -- five code controls for the cross-field constraints the schema walker cannot express
tests/test_badf_uat_evidence.py: 13 tests including additivity, the closed-enum property, and one test per code control
badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0110.json; work/WP-2026-0124/ record and G07 self-dossier; lockfile re-sign
out_of_scope: any execution adapter or subskill registration (browser-uat, api-uat, manual-uat) -- the adapter CONTRACT is frozen at rung A, concrete adapters are a later rung
scenario derivation logic -- this rung types the artifact, it does not generate it

deterministic G10/UAT controls beyond single-object validity: acceptance-basis digest binding across a dossier, freshness, staleness on candidate change -- that is WP-UAT-C, lean DISABLED (HARD INVARIANTS)
any lifecycle.json change; any second gate (UAT-I20); badf-production-readiness's release-packet and operational-readiness types
acceptance_criteria: schemas/uat.schema.json specializes evidence.schema.json with evidence_type const uat and gate const G10; an untyped uat binding is still admissible (additivity, the property VER-B and VAL-B established)

The recommendation enum is exactly four RECOMMEND_* values and contains no acceptance verdict; ACCEPTED / ACCEPTED_WITH_CONDITIONS / REJECTED exist only inside the Layer 2 acceptance object, which pins principal_type to const human

check_g10_uat_binding refuses: an observation naming a scenario absent from the binding (U2), a FAIL/BLOCKED observation with no classified defect (U3), RECOMMEND_ACCEPT with a critical scenario not passing (U4), a Layer 2 acceptance whose candidate_digest differs from the binding's (U5), and a Layer 2 acceptance with a non-human principal (U5)
Every code control observed RED against a neutered gate -- mutation battery reports 0 survivors
No lifecycle change, no second gate script, no adapter registered

test_obligations.claim: the recommendation vocabulary cannot express an acceptance and Layer 2 requires a human principal
each of the five code controls refuses its violation and is observed red when neutered
an untyped uat binding remains admissible after the typed form lands

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR; the rung is additive, so reverting restores the pre-typed admissibility exactly

note: Rung B of the badf-uat A→E ladder; A landed as #241 (c525129). SHARED-SURFACE (schemas/ + badf_gate.py) so this needs QA + REV, unlike rung A which was ladder-internal under the #248 classification. A SIXTH control (U1, acceptance-basis resolvability) was written and REMOVED: schemas/uat.schema.json already makes prd_digest required inside acceptance_basis, so check_schema refuses first and U1 could never fire. Its test passed on the wrong raise because BOTH messages contain 'prd_digest'. Found by this rung's own mutation battery -- #250's class in this rung's own code -- and recorded in a code comment so nobody re-adds it. Separately: the gate patch removing U1 silently FAILED on a first attempt while the test patch succeeded, and the suite went green anyway; caught by grepping for the code rather than trusting the exit status. Ids WP-2026-0124 / BADF-DEM-0110 / GOV-0116 swept clean on all four surfaces including my own unpushed worktrees.
